content: Man is the only creature who refuses to be what he is.
author: Albert Camus
story:
Raised in grinding poverty by a widowed, illiterate mother in working-class Algiers and battling chronic tuberculosis throughout his youth, Camus joined the French Resistance in occupied Paris, editing the clandestine newspaper Combat. Refusing both religious dogma and nihilistic despair, Camus championed the 'absurd hero'—one who recognizes the universe's silence yet rebels by living with passionate defiance, integrity, and love.

In formulating this reflection, Albert Camus stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of human condition. For Albert Camus, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: How does adopting this philosophical view alter the way you handle current friction?
